paragraphs: Welcome to the definitive home for your spiritual journey. If you are looking for a reliable, beautiful, and easy-to-use naam japa counter, you have arrived at the right place. Our mission is to provide devotees with a sacred digital space to track their radha naam jap, mantra counts, and daily spiritual progress without distractions.

In today's fast-paced digital world, maintaining a consistent spiritual practice can be challenging. Whether you are a seasoned practitioner or just starting your journey with radha naam jap, having a dedicated digital japa counter can make a significant difference. Our app is designed to be your constant companion, helping you stay connected to the divine with every tap.

A naam japa counter is more than just a simple tally tool. It is a spiritual bridge that helps practitioners maintain the discipline of "Japa" — the meditative repetition of a mantra or a divine name. Traditionally, this is done using a physical Mala (prayer beads), usually consisting of 108 beads. However, in modern life, carrying a physical Mala everywhere isn't always practical.
features: No Login Required: You don't need to give us your email or phone number.
No Cloud Sync: Your jaap counter data never leaves your phone.
Permanent Local Storage: We use a secure Room database to ensure your history is safe through app restarts, but it only lives where you live — on your phone.
Portability: You always have your phone with you. Whether you are commuting, in a waiting room, or traveling, your naam jaap counter is ready.
Accurate Logging: It is easy to forget how many malas you did yesterday. With our history logs, you have a perfect record of your journey.
